title: Pixel Stream Aligner
text: Align two streams of pixel data, 4 inputs, 3 outputs; {Line buffer size} sets the size of the line memory buffer and {Maximum number of lines} sets the buffer depth that accommodates the timing offset between input. Values come from the instance.
